title: Explainer storyboard
description: Model-agnostic description of an explainer video. The engine, the Runway plate generator and the shot-list exporter all read it.

sensitivity.description: From markings in the source. Anything but public: leave internal-only facts out and list them in excluded.

excluded.description: What was left out and why (internal detail, no room, unclear claim).

brand.description: Brand pack id from the Persistent Labs design system (scripts/brands.mjs list), e.g. persistent-labs, fireflow, fireflow/memorytree, privateinference.

products.description: Product fact files loaded from products/<brand>/<product>/SKILL.md.

formats.description: Vertical by default. Add 16x9 only when landscape is asked for (and set formats in video.tsx too).

role.description: The last scene is always the conclusion.

caption.description: Caption blocks (one sentence or phrase each). They appear 0.5 s apart. A word starting with * is highlighted in the brand accent.

visual.description: What happens on stage, in one or two sentences.

baseSeconds.description: Planned minimum length before the hold. The engine extends it to fit the captions' reading time.

plate.description: Optional generated background (Runway or another model). No text in plates.

tagline.description: Only a line the brand has approved.

url.description: Defaults to the brand URL from the design system.
